messages:
Tom (ACME): Hey team — starting ~00:12 UTC we saw a big spike of 429s from /v1/embeddings. Latency jumped then most requests got throttled. Billing shows token usage spike at same time. Org: acme-corp, route: embeddings.text-2, sample req id: r_8f3b2
Maya (Support): sorry to hear that — can you paste the response headers for a failed request (x-ratelimit-*, x-request-id) and the time range? also are these sync API calls or background workers? :eyes:
Tom (ACME): attaching quick snippet from our logs: ````
2026-03-15T00:12:31Z ERROR request_id=r_8f3b2 status=429 route=/v1/embeddings cost_tokens=420
Response headers: x-ratelimit-limit=1200 x-ratelimit-remaining=0 x-ratelimit-reset=161
````
OpsBot: ALERT: quota_exceeded tenant=acme-corp route=/v1/embeddings timestamp=2026-03-15T00:12:30Z severity=warning
Arjun (SRE): thanks — couple quick checks: 1) is this a scheduled batch job that runs on the hour? 2) do you batch multiple inputs into one request? 3) can you confirm whether you saw `x-ratelimit-remaining` hit 0 consistently or intermittent?
Tom (ACME): yes it's a cron worker that processes queued documents every 60m. we recently increased worker count in a deploy. we do batch ~50 items per request (not ideal). looks like remaining hit 0 for ~4 minutes.
Priya (Infra): probable pattern: concurrent cron workers + large batch sizes -> token burst that exhausts tenant quota. check tenant quota dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/tenants/acme-corp/quotas and the per-route token rate panel. run this quick query in the metrics UI: `sum(rate(tokens_consumed_total{tenant="acme-corp",route="/v1/embeddings"}[1m])) by (route)`
Maya (Support): next action: can you share one full failing response (headers + body) and a request sample (without PII)? if you can't paste here, DM me. I'll open an interim escalation for quota bump while we investigate. :thumbsup:
Tom (ACME): pasted one DM'ed to you. here's the request pattern from our worker (pseudo): ````
for chunk in chunks(input_docs, size=50):
  resp = client.embeddings.create(model="embeddings.text-2", input=chunk)
  if resp.status == 429: retry_with_backoff()
````
Arjun (SRE): a few mitigations: - reduce batch size to 8-12, add jittered exponential backoff for 429s, and gate concurrent cron jobs with a leader election lock. Also enable per-tenant token-rate alert: threshold > 150k tokens/min for now.
Diego (Product): we should add an automated guard in the SDK too to warn about huge batch sizes for embeddings (common footgun). I'll create a ticket.
Maya (Support): I'm provisioning a temporary 2x quota bump for acme-corp for 24h to reduce customer impact — please confirm when you roll a worker patch. also I'm creating an internal ticket: INC-2638 to track follow-ups.
Priya (Infra): note: our dashboards show prefix cache disabled for this tenant on that model flavor (likely due to input shape variation). prefix caching would have reduced token compute. I'm flagging infra item to investigate caching heuristics for embeddings routes.
Tom (ACME): rolling a quick patch now to reduce batch -> 10 and add leader lock. will monitor. thanks all.
OpsBot: NOTE: quota bump applied to tenant=acme-corp expires=2026-03-16T00:12:30Z by=Maya
Arjun (SRE): follow-ups for postmortem: - reproduce locally with identical worker pattern - instrument per-route per-tenant token-rate alerting and add a dashboard tile for top-10 tenants by token/sec - document recommended max batch sizes per model (embeddings.text-2 -> 8-16)
Maya (Support): resolution plan: temp bump applied, customer patching worker now, support to monitor for 24h, infra investigating cache heuristic, product to add SDK warning. will reconvene tomorrow 10:00 UTC for post-check. :white_check_mark:
Tom (ACME): confirmed reduction deployed at 00:24 UTC. seeing <10% 429s in last 3m and token rate is back under threshold. thanks everyone.
Diego (Product): filing follow-up tickets and a small UX nudge in quickstart for embeddings about batch sizing.
Maya (Support): closing escalation once we verify stable for 24h. leaving INC-2638 open until postmortem and dashboards updated.
